name: Chrono Metronome

name: Armor Garden
description: Gain +4 max HP and heal 4 HP when acquired, start each battle with 4 shield, and recover 3 HP after every victory.

name: Bounty Drone
description: Start each battle with +1 speed and gain 12 gold after every victory.

name: Prism Furnace
description: Start each battle with +1 attack, 8 shield, and 4% faster casts.

name: Archive Compass
description: Increase loadout capacity by 1, then gain 8 gold and recover 2 HP after every victory.

name: Triplet Relay
description: Every third manually resolved card reduces the longest recast among other cards by 4 seconds, up to 4 times per battle.

name: Borrowed Second Hand
description: When a card effectively delays an enemy, haste your frontmost active card by 35% of that delay, up to 2 seconds, with a 6-second cooldown.

name: Terminal Echo Ring
description: When a manual card resolves with no other allied card active, reduce the previous different card's recast by 2 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds.

name: Four-Name Quartet
description: Resolve 4 different manual cards in sequence to reduce every recast by 2.5 seconds, up to 3 times per battle.

name: Dead-Heat Needle
description: If your card is due up to 0.2 seconds after an enemy card, align their times and give your card +0.01 priority. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

name: Silent Three-Second Timer
description: After your timeline stays empty for 3 seconds, the next card casts 30% faster but has 25% longer recast.

name: Delay Return Gear
description: When an enemy delays your card, deduct 50% of the effective delay from its recast after resolution, up to 4 seconds per instance.

name: Zero-Hour Clapper
description: At 10, 20, and 30 battle seconds, haste the allied frontmost card that was already active by 1 second.

name: Terminal Bell
description: After the same enemy card is delayed 3 times, interrupt it if possible; otherwise delay it 3 more seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

name: Paradox Mortgage
description: Your stop and reverse effects last 30% longer, up to 2 extra seconds, but their source card gains 6 seconds of recast afterward.

name: Overtake Signal
description: When haste moves your card ahead of an enemy card, gain 3 shield and give your next Attack +2 damage. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

name: Reversal Turbine
description: When reverse moves your manual card rightward, add +1 to its main effect per second moved, up to +4.

name: Full-Slot Bell
description: When a normal resolution frees a full 3/3 slot board, gain 4 shield; gain 2 instead after an interrupt. Cooldown: 4 seconds.

name: Vacancy Interest Meter
description: For every empty normal slot that remains open for 3 seconds, gain a charge. The next card is hasted by 0.8 seconds per charge, up to 3 charges.

name: Fourth Reserve Rack
description: Gain 1 active slot. While all 4 slots are occupied, cast progress is 25% slower and cooldown progress is 20% slower.

name: Single-Seat Duel Sheath
description: A slot-cost 2 or greater card cast alone is 15% faster, but no other card can be committed until it resolves. Minimum cast: 1 second.

name: Reserved Seat Tag
description: When an interruptible enemy card is active, reserve your last open slot for interrupt cards and make those cards cast 20% faster. This behavior can be toggled.

name: Echo Rectifier
description: When an auto-queued card resolves, reduce its direct manual source card's recast by 1.5 seconds, up to 3 times per source.

name: Waste-Heat Printer
description: Gain 1 heat when an auto-queued card resolves. At 3 heat, cancel the next auto-queue and reduce the longest recast by 6 seconds.

name: Isolation Chamber
description: Gain 1 auxiliary slot for auto-queued cards only. Cards there cast 20% faster; further auto-queues fail while it is occupied.

name: Resin Memory Block
description: Whenever an auto-queued card resolves, its manual source card gains +1 to its main effect for this battle, up to +5 per card.

name: Full Absorption Gauge
description: When shield fully absorbs an enemy Attack, reduce the longest recast by 1.5 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds; maximum 5 times per battle.

name: Evaporation Recovery Valve
description: For every 3 shield lost to natural decay, gain a token that reduces the next shield-spend cost by 1, up to 3 tokens.

name: Residual Pressure Detonator
description: If a shield-spend card leaves exactly 0 shield, haste it by 20% of its base cast, up to 3 seconds. Cooldown: 6 seconds.

name: Rupture Insurance Film
description: Once per battle, when a shield-spend card is interrupted, refund 50% of its payment and set its recast to 70%.

name: Compression Caliper
description: At 12 or more shield, natural decay slows to 1 every 2 seconds, but shield-spend costs increase by 2.

name: Twilight Pacemaker
description: At 43% HP or less, Attack and Control cards cast 9% faster; at 49% HP or more, Shield and Heal effects are 8% stronger.

name: Bleed Pulsator
description: When you take a bleed tick, haste your frontmost active card by 0.8 seconds; if none is active, reduce the longest recast by 0.8 seconds. Maximum 6 times per battle.

name: Slow-Charge Accumulator
description: When you manually commit a card while slowed, add +1 to its main effect for every 0.5 seconds of cast added by slow, up to +3.

name: Four-Symptom Seal
description: Once per battle, when the enemy holds 4 negative statuses at once, stop its timeline for 2 seconds and reduce each status's remaining duration by 6 seconds.

name: Quarantine Buffer
description: Once per battle, hold the first negative status applied to you for 6 seconds; it has no effect and does not tick during that delay.

name: Symptom Transfer Paper
description: When a card removes your negative status, apply that status to the enemy for 40% of its remaining duration, up to 2 statuses per battle.

name: Critical Pathology Meter
description: When an enemy status expires naturally, bleed deals one final tick; other statuses delay the enemy's frontmost card by 1.2 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds.

name: Grade Staircase
description: Once per battle, manually resolve Grades 0, 1, 2, and 3 in order to gain 10 shield and reduce every recast by 3 seconds.

name: Unpolished Motherboard
description: If at least 2 Base cards are equipped, each after the first costs 1 less loadout capacity but casts 12% slower, with a maximum total discount of 3.

name: Overload Seal
description: You may exceed the loadout limit by 2. Start each battle with 12 seconds of vulnerable for every point over the limit.

name: Empty-Rack Bus
description: Gain 1 active slot for every 3 unused loadout capacity, up to +2 slots.

name: Full-Load Latch
description: If equipped cost exactly matches the loadout limit, the first card costing 2 or more slots each battle costs 1 fewer slot.

name: Weight Ticket Punch
description: When a loadout-cost 5 card resolves, reduce recast on cost 1-2 cards by 2.5 seconds, up to 3 times per battle.

name: Grade Differential Wheel
description: Resolve a lower Grade within 8 seconds of a higher Grade to reduce the later card's recast by 1.5 seconds per Grade of difference, up to 4.5 seconds.

name: Solar Pinion
description: On pickup, imprint 1 card. Its base cast is 1 second shorter and its recast is 15% longer. Minimum cast: 0.6 seconds.

name: Overcharge Confection Furnace
description: The imprinted card's first use each battle has 40% stronger numeric effects, then enters a cooldown of at least 60 seconds.

name: Polarization Converter
description: Imprint a pure Attack or Shield card. Convert Shield to 65% Damage or Damage to 80% Shield, and add 0.6 seconds to its cast.

name: Balanced Three-Phase Unit
description: Imprint a heavy or extreme-timing card and set it to slot cost 1, cast 4 seconds, and recast 30 seconds, with each main effect capped at 8.

name: Memorial Fund Coil
description: Bank 1 victory gold for every 2 shield paid to shield-spend cards, up to 12 gold per battle.

name: Seven-Step Validator
description: On entering Steps 7, 14, 21, and 28, upgrade 1 equipped card of the lowest Grade. Thresholds passed before pickup do not count.

name: Depth Pressure Gauge
description: In Hazard waves after the first, gain wave minus 1 active slots, but casts take 5% longer for each wave.

name: Emergency Recovery Line
description: Once per run, fatal damage during Hazard wave 2 or later leaves you at 1 HP and forces withdrawal, preserving earlier wave rewards but losing the current wave reward.

name: Carryover Price Tag
description: Arena offers held into the next round cost 4 less per carried round, up to 16 less.

name: Defeat Wiring
description: After an Arena loss, begin the next battle with 4 active slots for the first 15 seconds.

name: Overtime Key
description: When acquired in Arena, increase both allowed losses and required wins by 1.

name: Loop-Wear Wheel
description: At each 28-step Infinite boundary, permanently reduce recast by 1 second on the equipped card with the highest base recast, up to 4 per card and 12 total.
